answer: Require every agent to lock a meaningful bond in a common vault before it can trade, with the bond tied to one verified work history rather than a disposable name. A sybil attacker must fund each fake identity separately, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand bonds, while honest agents keep one bond in their haven of trusted counterparties. Misbehaviour slashes the bond and stains that history like a pigment that cannot be washed off, so old fakes cannot be reused cheaply.
